name: Destruction in Deadmines
summary: Destruction in Deadmines is a clandestine mission overseen by Alba Fairmoon in Westfall. With the explosives planted beside the Defias forge deep in the Deadmines, the operative rejoins Alba in the hills behind Moonbrook and triggers the detonator from a safe distance.

sections.title: Sabotage Beneath Westfall
sections.body: The Deadmines have long harbored the core strength of the Defias Brotherhood, serving as both a stronghold and an industrial nerve center right beneath Westfall. Rather than relying solely on a direct assault through every fortified corridor, Alba Fairmoon directs a decisive act of sabotage. By planting explosives and detonating them within the subterranean complex, Alliance operatives aim to collapse vital infrastructure and derail whatever schemes the brotherhood is orchestrating in the dark.

sections.title: The Detonator
sections.body: Carrying out this assignment requires a steady hand and precise timing. The charge already sits beside the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and the remote detonator lets it be set off from well outside the caves. Alba hopes that with the forge gone, the poisoned land of Westfall can begin to heal.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Destruction in Deadmines?
faq.answer: The mission is given by Alba Fairmoon, an operative stationed in Westfall who directs Alliance adventurers to strike directly at the Defias Brotherhood's stronghold.

faq.q: What is the primary objective of this mission?
aliases: what do i do in destruction in deadmines
how to complete destruction in deadmines
faq.answer: You use the detonator to set off the explosives planted beside the Defias forge in the Deadmines, triggering them from outside the mines once you have rejoined Alba Fairmoon.

faq.q: Why target the Deadmines with explosives?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon traced the poison corrupting Westfall's farmland to a large metallurgical forge hidden in the Deadmines. Destroying it is her hope for letting the land begin to heal.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: It takes place in Westfall, in the hills behind Moonbrook outside the Deadmines, where Alba Fairmoon waits for you after the explosives are planted.

faq.q: Is this mission available to Horde players?
aliases: is destruction in deadmines alliance only
can horde do destruction in deadmines
faq.answer: No. Alba Fairmoon works exclusively with Alliance operatives defending Westfall against the rising threat of the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What threat does the Defias Brotherhood pose in Westfall?
aliases: what are defias doing in deadmines
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has driven out farmers, raided settlements, and seized the abandoned mines of Westfall. Operating from deep within the Deadmines, they are building an armed insurrection that directly threatens the kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: Demolition and remotely triggered detonators are central to this assignment, appealing to engineers who appreciate the fine art of controlled structural collapses.
Infiltrating enemy territory to plant charges and slip out before the explosion makes this mission a classic exercise in covert sabotage.
Every blow struck against the Defias stronghold in the Deadmines helps safeguard the struggling farmsteads of Westfall and the southern border of Stormwind.
